about.title: About
about.p1: I'm Finnian. Frontend background, now focused on AI applications and interaction, based in Dongguan. This site doubles as my motion lab — GSAP, Rive and Lottie all show up here.
about.p2: Away from work I write, rarely publish. I take animation mechanics apart for fun and collect odd, useful open-source tools. Come say hi.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p: I check my inbox twice a day, with the same hands-in-pockets patience this page is drawn with. Write to me about agents, interfaces, a role you think fits — or just to say hi.
